# add-competitor-and-entry

# Add a new competitor and their first entry

Create a competitor from the Competitors page, then enter them in a class from their profile. This guide is for show office staff and secretaries taking entries at the office or over the phone.

## Before you start

- Sign in as **office staff**.
- Make sure **Riverbend Show 2026** is the current show.

## Steps

### Part 1: Add the competitor

#### 1. Check the current show

Sign in and start on the **Dashboard**. Check the **Current show** at the bottom of the left-hand menu is the show you're taking entries for.

![Check the current show](screenshots/step-01.png)

#### 2. Open Competitors

Click **Competitors** in the left-hand menu.

![Open Competitors](screenshots/step-02.png)

#### 3. Search before you add

Competitors are shared across all your shows. Type the person's name into **Search competitors...** first, so you don't create a duplicate. If they're already listed, skip ahead to [their profile](#8-open-their-profile).

![Search before you add](screenshots/step-03.png)

#### 4. Add New Competitor

No match? Click **Add New Competitor** at the top right.

![Add New Competitor](screenshots/step-04.png)

#### 5. Enter their name

Enter the competitor's **First Name** and **Last Name** (both required, at least two characters).

![Enter their name](screenshots/step-05.png)

#### 6. Add contact details

**Email** and **Phone** are optional. With an email address, TallyUp sends the competitor an entry confirmation and you can email them a payment link later.

![Add contact details](screenshots/step-06.png)

#### 7. Create Competitor

Click **Create Competitor**. A *Competitor created* message appears and you're returned to the competitor list.

![Create Competitor](screenshots/step-07.png)

### Part 2: Add the entry

#### 8. Open their profile

Search for the competitor again and click **View** on their row to open their profile.

![Open their profile](screenshots/step-08.png)

#### 9. Add Entry

The profile shows their details and entries for this show (none yet). Under **Quick Actions**, click **Add Entry**.

![Add Entry](screenshots/step-09.png)

#### 10. Competitor already selected

The **Add New Entry** form opens with the competitor already selected.

![Competitor already selected](screenshots/step-10.png)

#### 11. Choose a class

Click **Select a class...** and search by class name, code or section — for example `banana` — then click the class (shown as code and name, e.g. *CK03 - Banana bread*).

![Choose a class](screenshots/step-11.png)

#### 12. Entry number and fee

For automatically numbered classes the form notes *Entry numbers will be assigned automatically when you submit.* The **Entry Summary** on the right adds up the fees. (Classes with hand-entered numbers, such as poultry cage numbers, show an **Entry Number (Optional)** box instead.)

![Entry number and fee](screenshots/step-12.png)

#### 13. Optional description

Optionally add an **Entry Description**. To enter the same competitor in more classes, click **Add Another Entry** and repeat for each class.

![Optional description](screenshots/step-13.png)

#### 14. Submit Entry

Check the details and click **Submit Entry**.

![Submit Entry](screenshots/step-14.png)

#### 15. Entry submitted

The entry is saved with its entry number and shows **Payment Pending**. Choose **Send Link** to email a secure payment link, or **Record Payment** for cash or EFTPOS. **Create Another Entry** starts a fresh form.

![Entry submitted](screenshots/step-15.png)

## Good to know

- Search Competitors first
- Add New Competitor
- Open their profile, then Add Entry
- Choose a class and Submit Entry

---

*Steps verified against the real app on 2026-10-22.*

# filter-unpaid-entries

# Find unpaid entries

Filter the entries list to show only entries that haven't been paid. This guide is for show office staff following up entry fees.

## Before you start

- Sign in as **office staff**.
- Make sure **Riverbend Show 2026** is the current show.

## Steps

### Part 1: Filter entries

#### 1. Open Entries

Click **Entries** in the left-hand menu.

![Open Entries](screenshots/step-01.png)

#### 2. Choose Unpaid

Open **Payment Status** and choose **\{\{filter.status\}\}**.

![Choose Unpaid](screenshots/step-02.png)

#### 3. Apply Filters

Click **Apply Filters**. The list shows only unpaid entries.

![Apply Filters](screenshots/step-03.png)

## Good to know

- Open Entries
- Choose Unpaid under Payment Status
- Apply Filters

---

*Steps verified against the real app on 2026-10-23.*

# record-a-payment

# Record a payment

Record an entry fee a competitor paid at the office. This guide is for show office staff taking entry fees at the office.

## Before you start

- Sign in as **office staff**.
- Make sure **Riverbend Show 2026** is the current show.

## Steps

### Part 1: Record the payment

#### 1. Open Payments

Click **Payments** in the left-hand menu.

![Open Payments](screenshots/step-01.png)

#### 2. New Payment

Click **New Payment**.

![New Payment](screenshots/step-02.png)

#### 3. Choose the competitor

Click **Select competitor...** and choose the person who paid.

![Choose the competitor](screenshots/step-03.png)

#### 4. Enter the amount

Enter the **Amount ($)**. **Payment Type** is already **Entry Fee** and **Payment Method** is **Cash**.

![Enter the amount](screenshots/step-04.png)

#### 5. Enter the receipt number

Enter the **Receipt Number**, if you gave one.

![Enter the receipt number](screenshots/step-05.png)

#### 6. Save Payment

Click **Save Payment**. The payment shows in the **Payments** list.

![Save Payment](screenshots/step-06.png)

## Good to know

- Open Payments
- New Payment
- Choose the competitor
- Enter the amount and receipt number
- Save Payment

---

*Steps verified against the real app on 2026-10-23.*

# update-a-competitors-phone

# Update a competitor's phone number

Find a competitor, open their profile, and change their phone number. This guide is for show office staff keeping competitor details current.

## Before you start

- Sign in as **office staff**.
- Make sure **Riverbend Show 2026** is the current show.

## Steps

### Part 1: Find the competitor

#### 1. Search for the competitor

On **Competitors**, type the person's name in **Search**.

![Search for the competitor](screenshots/step-01.png)

#### 2. Open their profile

Click **View** on the competitor's row.

![Open their profile](screenshots/step-02.png)

### Part 2: Change the phone number

#### 3. Edit Profile

Click **Edit Profile**.

![Edit Profile](screenshots/step-03.png)

#### 4. Change the phone number

Replace the number in **Phone**.

![Change the phone number](screenshots/step-04.png)

#### 5. Save Changes

Click **Save Changes**. The profile shows the new number.

![Save Changes](screenshots/step-05.png)

## Good to know

- Search Competitors
- Open their profile
- Edit Profile
- Change the phone number and save

---

*Steps verified against the real app on 2026-10-23.*
